what_changed: The sung shot is gone. On the held 'Rewind.' (119.44) the failed wall climb runs backwards (R1). The ghost ladder, the haul, the hint slide, the swarm boost and the split each play two bars earlier, so she becomes two at 128.32. From that moment the twins are BLUE and ORANGE by costume (band, straps, dots, headphones); there are no tags. Then a co-op level at 129.18-134.88, before the Super Meat Boy replay. There is a gap with a giant pencil for a drawbridge, which is down only while a floor button is held. ORANGE stamps the near button (130.50): it sinks and the pencil swings down. BLUE crosses and holds the far button. Agents run in; ORANGE springs off as their hands close on air, crosses, and the agents stop at the lip. BLUE lets go (134.00): the bridge swings up out of their reach, and both run on. The world, the pencil and the buttons stay black and white. The stopwatch insert is gone and the replay starts at 134.88; 136.62 on and the 141.00 hand-over are unchanged. Button and bridge sounds are new (procedural). Two Seedance takes plus keyframe edits, $3.46. Stills: 0200_coop_split.png, _hold.png, _swap.png, _bridge_up.png. Follow-ups: both twins' bun pencils stay yellow; HILBERT HOTEL on the E7 billboards; the 101.14 miss now has the turf sound.

what_changed: Feet: the white sneakers had been dropped from the girls' mattes; they now stand on the desk in every frame. Mechanism: the pencil is one rigid engine sprite on a drawn iron hinge at the near lip, visible from the first frame; it starts raised, swings down at 130.50 and lifts the other way at 134.00. Agents: a new Seedance take of two agents on blank paper, matted and placed. They run in behind ORANGE (131.38), lunge where she was (132.70) and run out onto the bridge after her. When BLUE lets go (134.00), the far end lifts under them and flings them back over the hinge onto the near desk (134.44), where they sit up dazed; nobody falls into the gap. New procedural sound coop_bridge_throw (twang, whoosh, two landing thumps). Stills: 0200_coop_bridge_up.png, 0200_coop_throw.png. Cost $0.88 (one keyframe, one take). Hard cut at 133.56: the white flash on the C2b cut had washed the frames into what looked like a double exposure, so it was removed. Geography checked frame by frame from 133.5 to 134.42: the agents always come in from the left and stay on the near desk, left of the hinge; the girls are on the far desk (right of x 1230 of 1920); the raised pencil stands between them.
